description.value: A Walmart Supercenter located at 9855 Austin Avenue in Burnaby, offering a full grocery section alongside general merchandise including electronics, clothing, and baby goods. As one of the largest retail formats in the area, it provides a one-stop resupply opportunity for touring cyclists needing food staples, household supplies, or minor gear. The on-site optometrist and key-cutting service suggest a broad service footprint typical of a full Supercenter format.
